title: Agnew Bahnson's plane crash

tellings.quote: he dies a couple of years later in a bizarre plane crash which to this day his family thinks, you know, he was killed essentially

plain: An American industrialist named Agnew Bahnson died in a strange plane crash in the early 1960s, and according to Michels his family believes to this day that he was in effect killed. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about secrecy around UFOs. If true, it would suggest that someone wanted Bahnson silenced.
